summary: The HSPnetDropDownList is a custom implementation of a DropDownList control in a web application. It includes features for highlighting the dropdown list items based on selection and providing an 'ALL' option.
purpose: The purpose of the HSPnetDropDownList is to provide a dropdown list with custom behavior for highlighting selected items and handling an optional 'ALL' selection.

fields.name: ALL
fields.description: Determines if the 'ALL' option is included in the dropdown.

fields.name: FirstItemIsALL
fields.description: Indicates if the first item in the dropdown is the 'ALL' option.

workflows.name: Dropdown Rendering
steps: Check if the selected index is greater than 0.
If selected index > 0, set dropdown color to red.
Else, set dropdown color to black.
If ALL is set, insert 'ALL' as first item on DataBound.

conditions: If ALL is true, 'ALL' is inserted as the first item.
Selected index > 0 sets dropdown color to red.
system_behavior: The dropdown's appearance changes based on the selected item.
The 'ALL' option can be included based on the ALL property.
